data.name: Mughni
data.gender_notes: Mughni is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mughni is a name that signifies self-sufficiency and independence. It is derived from the Arabic root 'gh-n-y', which means to be rich or free from need. The name Mughni carries the meaning “One who is independent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mughni usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is independent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mughni is considered a name that reflects the concept of tawakkul, or trust in Allah's provision.
data.etymology: Mughni belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is independent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mughni total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: مغني
in_arabic.long_meaning: المغني اسم علم عربي معناه الذي يغني العالمين ودارين ويراد به الذي يغني الفقراء والمساكين ولهذا الاسم في الإسلام أهمية كبيرة في تسمية الأطفال، ويتضمن معناه الفعلي التبرع لغيره من الناس ويشبه كلمة مغيث، ويُعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى في القرآن الكريم، وفي التراث الإسلامي يُستخدم أيضاً في تسمية الأزواج والمحبين، ويُعتبر من أسماء الذكور الرجالية

in_urdu.name: مغنی
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو دنیا اور آخرت کے لیے غنی ہو، جو دنیا اور آخرت کے لیے کافی ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: مغنی نام کا مطلب ہے جو شخص دنیا اور آخرت کے لیے غنی ہو، جو دنیا اور آخرت کے لیے کافی ہو، یہ نام ایک بہت بڑا نام ہے جو اسلامی دنیا میں بہت مشہور ہے، اس نام کا تعلق ہے عرب زبان سے، یہ نام کے معنی ہیں جو دنیا اور آخرت کے لیے غنی ہو، اس نام کا زیادہ استعمال ہے جنوبی ایشیائی ممالک میں، اور اس کا تعلق ہے ایک بڑے صحابی رسول اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم سے جو نام مغنی تھا

in_hindi.name: मुघ्नी
in_hindi.meaning: जो दुनिया और आखिरत के लिए गुणवान है, जो दुनिया और आखिरत के लिए पर्याप्त है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुघ्नी नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति दुनिया और आखिरत के लिए गुणवान है, जो दुनिया और आखिरत के लिए पर्याप्त है, यह नाम एक बहुत ही बड़ा नाम है जो इस्लामी दुनिया में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है, इस नाम का संबंध अरब भाषा से है, इसका अर्थ है जो दुनिया और आखिरत के लिए गुणवान है, इस नाम का अधिक उपयोग है भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में

in_english.name: Mughni
in_english.meaning: The one who makes others rich, the one who provides for others, the one who is self-sufficient
in_english.long_meaning: Mughni is a name with a rich history and cultural significance in Islamic tradition. It means the one who makes others rich, the one who provides for others, the one who is self-sufficient. The root of the name 'Mughni' is derived from the Arabic root 'Gh-N-Y' which means to make rich or to provide for someone. The name has been used in various forms and interpretations throughout Islamic history, including in the Quran and in the names of notable Islamic figures. In Islamic tradition, the name Mughni is associated with the qualities of generosity, kindness, and self-sufficiency. Those who bear this name are believed to possess these qualities and are often seen as leaders or role models in their communities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mughni holds a rich cultural significance in the Arab world, particularly among the Muslim community. The name Mughni is often given to children as a symbol of hope and aspiration for a prosperous and self-sufficient future. It is a reminder that no matter the circumstances, individuals have the capacity to provide for themselves and their families, and to overcome hardships through determination and perseverance.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mughni holds deeper symbolism. It serves as an reminder of the belief in self-sufficiency and reliance on God (Allah) for sustenance and guidance. The name Mughni reflects the Islamic principles of Tawakkul (relying on God) and Sadqah (giving generously to others). Thus, it is a name that inspires individuals to seek self-improvement, to strive towards independence while remaining mindful of their spiritual obligations, and to act as a source of help and support for others in need.
